Graves.combo: If Graves still has a dash available, don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to engage first. Walk in, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, build stacks with your basic attacks and an allied melee champion’s basic attacks, then stun with Sejuani E Permafrost.
Graves.build: Graves’s main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps earlier and build armor first. If the enemy team has strong physical damage and many champions who close in to fight with basic attacks, buy Thornmail earlier too.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw is down, he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so check whether he has any other mobility available. In particular, close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back, then use Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, leave the area and regain vision before engaging.
Graves.fight: Fight back or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Take fights in open areas with Sejuani P Fury of the North active, and watch whether Graves E Quickdraw and Graves R Collateral Damage have been used before you engage.
Graves.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to level up and start fights in lanes where your ally already has the advantage. Before ganking, stop attacking camps briefly to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North, and look for lanes where the enemy has a long way to retreat. An allied melee champion’s basic attacks also help build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks.
Graves.phase: Early on, Sejuani should clear camps safely and choose fights in advantageous lanes over risky kill attempts. Graves gets stronger as stacks of Graves E Quickdraw build, so pressure his opportunities to scale from the start and keep in mind that the matchup gets worse as the game goes on.
Graves.teamfight: When your ally’s damage dealer can attack immediately, look for an angle to hit Graves with Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, lock him down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost, then land a basic attack after the stun. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the enemy’s approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save your ultimate.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. If Graves W Smoke Screen hits you, leave its area by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves P New Destiny’s basic attack is blocked by the first unit it hits, so keep minions or allies between you and Graves.

Belveth.laning: In the early game, farm camps safely to gain levels, and start fights around allied lanes that already have an advantage. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait briefly to activate Frost Armor. Choose a lane where the enemy has pushed toward the turret and has a long distance to retreat, especially one where an allied melee champion can help build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks.
Belveth.build: Build armor first to withstand Bel'Veth’s main source of physical damage. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet deals true damage that resistances cannot mitigate, so build health as well. If the enemy team has heavy physical damage and several champions who stay on you with basic attacks, build Thornmail earlier.
Belveth.fight: Choose fights where Frost Armor is active and your allies can deal damage alongside you. When Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, don’t try to deal heavy damage; interrupt it with Sejuani E Permafrost or attack after it ends. When Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down, chain crowd control to lock her down before she can move again.
Belveth.combo: If Bel'Veth still has a mobility ability available, don’t start with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. Once stacks are full, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack to deal Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when Bel'Veth tries to escape using a mobility ability.
Belveth.escape: After sidestepping Bel'Veth W Above and Below, you have a good window to avoid pursuit or start a fight. If Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has been used, close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault while she cannot immediately dash again in that same direction, then lock her down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. Bel'Veth may still have a dash in another direction, so don’t blindly go too deep just because one Q has been used.
Belveth.phase: Still, Sejuani should focus on leveling safely and fighting alongside allies with an advantage instead of forcing early kills.
Belveth.teamfight: With Frost Armor active, use Sejuani R Glacial Prison on a target your allied damage dealers can attack immediately. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, and Sejuani E Permafrost to lock them down. If your allies can’t follow up from their position, slow Bel'Veth’s engage with W from the front and save R. If an ally dies and Bel'Veth is about to get a Void Coral, retreat; delay the team fight while Bel'Veth is transformed.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and slows you, while also helping Bel'Veth Q Void Surge come back sooner. When Bel'Veth closes in, sidestep W instead of running straight backward. Don’t unload damage during Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom; wait for it to end or interrupt it with the stun from Sejuani E Permafrost.

Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target it hits, so dodge it with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns enemies in an area, so don’t group with allies while Amumu has R available, and keep your distance before he gets close. Amumu W Despair deals continuous max-health-based damage, so don’t stay near him for long.
Amumu.escape: When Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses, that’s your chance to engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. If Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is also down, you have less reason to worry about its area stun, and Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own.
Amumu.teamfight: Fight in open areas with space between you and your allies so Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy cannot catch several of you at once. If your allied damage dealers can attack right away, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at a backline damage dealer, then follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, and Sejuani E Permafrost to lock them down. If your allies can’t follow up, slow Amumu’s engage with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath from the front and save R.
Amumu.build: Build magic resistance against Amumu’s magic damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance, making this especially effective. Resistances do not reduce the true damage from Amumu P Cursed Touch, and Amumu W Despair deals max-health-based damage, so avoid relying on health alone.
Amumu.combo: If your allies can deal damage right away, hit the target from long range with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to build stacks, then stun with Sejuani E Permafrost once they’re full. Immediately after the stun, land one basic attack to deal Sejuani P Fury of the North’s bonus max-health-based damage.
Amumu.fight: Engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to close in, then lock him down with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. Keep the fight short so you don’t take Amumu W Despair’s damage for long.
Amumu.laning: Stop attacking camps briefly before you engage to keep Sejuani P Fury of the North’s Frost Armor active.
Amumu.phase: Afterward, build defensive items to increase your durability and the damage of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath.

MonkeyKing.phase: Early on, Sejuani should focus on gaining levels safely instead of rushing for kills, and avoid extended duels with Wukong. Later, build defensive items and start teamfights, but keep allies spread out if Wukong R Cyclone is available.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong's primary physical damage. Armor doesn't mitigate the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike, but Wukong R Cyclone scales with max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If the enemy team has heavy physical damage and many champions who engage at close quarters with basic attacks, get Thornmail earlier.
MonkeyKing.combo: If Wukong still has a mobility spell, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, then fill the stacks with basic attacks and stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost. Land one basic attack right after the stun to deal max-health bonus damage. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault the moment Wukong tries to escape with a mobility spell.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is used, before it returns, is a chance to engage. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch him with Sejuani E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison. The moment after Wukong R Cyclone is down is also a good time to fight or start an objective.
MonkeyKing.fight: Sejuani's primary magic damage is effective against Wukong's low magic resistance, so trade briefly when he engages. Prolonged fights build Wukong P Stone Skin's armor and healing, so repeat short trades where you engage and disengage. Don't use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first to engage while Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike are available.
MonkeyKing.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in allied lanes that already have an advantage. For ganks, choose a lane where the enemy has moved far from their turret and has a long distance to retreat. Before engaging, avoid taking damage briefly to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North's defensive effect. Basic attacks from allied melee champions also contribute to Sejuani E Permafrost stacks.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: When Wukong R Cyclone is ready, keep your distance from allies and don't mistake a Wukong W Warrior Trickster clone for the real Wukong and waste crowd control on it. If an allied damage dealer can attack immediately, hit the enemy backline from long range with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch them with W Winter's Wrath and E Permafrost. If allies can't follow up, slow the engage from the front with W Winter's Wrath and save R.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash and can't be dodged while you're in range, and the follow-up Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster creates a clone, don't use abilities on the clone left behind; watch which way the real Wukong escapes.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar’s main sources of damage: Briar P Crimson Curse, Briar Q Head Rush, and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Briar E Chilling Scream and Briar R Certain Death deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t stop them. If her healing makes the duel drag on, consider anti-heal after building resistances.
Briar.combo: If Briar still has her mobility ability, don’t lead with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Walk in and land all of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to build stacks. Once they’re full, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost and immediately land one basic attack to deal damage based on her max health. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when Briar tries to escape with her mobility ability.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is also a way for her to move, so check which mobility abilities she still has; especially look for an opening before Briar R Certain Death is available again. Close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then lock her down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Briar.fight: Start fights when Sejuani P Fury of the North is active and your allies can attack with you. While Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is active, she charges at nearby enemies, so absorb it from the front and slow her with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. If Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, interrupt it with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or a ready Sejuani E Permafrost.
Briar.laning: Early on, safely clear jungle camps to gain levels, and focus your ganks on lanes where your allies have an advantage. Before engaging, briefly avoid taking damage to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North, and choose a lane where the enemy has a long distance to retreat. Don’t linger in areas without vision, and use Briar’s reckless engages as opportunities to counterattack.
Briar.phase: Early on, Briar has high kill participation, so Sejuani should focus on safe jungle routes and vision instead of forcing fights. Later, build defensive items to improve your survivability and fight alongside your allies.
Briar.teamfight: When Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack activates, stand in front of your backline damage dealers and let her charge at you. Cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison on a target your allied damage dealers can attack immediately. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then lock the target down with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can’t follow up, slow her advance with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath from the front.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces armor and magic resist, so watch your spacing to avoid it. When Briar E Chilling Scream begins charging, interrupt it with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and avoid fighting with your back to a wall so you aren’t knocked into one when hit by the scream. Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone marks the first champion it hits as its target, so stand in front and absorb it instead of letting it reach your backline damage dealers.

Rammus.phase: In the late game, Sejuani’s survivability and damage both increase as her defensive core items come together, so start fights alongside your allies.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If most of the enemy team’s damage is magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on your own magic resistance, making your investment more effective.
Rammus.combo: If Rammus R Soaring Slam is still available, don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first. Walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. Once you have enough stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost, then follow with Q Arctic Assault when he tries to escape with R Soaring Slam. When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is inactive, land one basic attack on the stunned Rammus to get the bonus damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North.
Rammus.escape: If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is still available, wait outside its range and use Q Arctic Assault after the taunt ends.
Rammus.fight: While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, he has high defenses and reflects damage from basic attacks, so don’t dump your damage into him. Once W ends, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to build stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost, then land one basic attack to deal Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage.
Rammus.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Choose lanes where the enemy has a long distance to retreat. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait for Sejuani P Fury of the North’s Frost Armor to activate. When an allied melee champion attacks Rammus, Sejuani E Permafrost stacks faster too.
Rammus.teamfight: Activate Frost Armor, then throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at an enemy backline damage dealer when your allied damage dealers can attack immediately. If it hits, go in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch them with W Winter’s Wrath and E Permafrost, but avoid the expanded landing area of R Soaring Slam after Rammus Q Powerball. If your allies aren’t in position to follow up, save R Glacial Prison and slow the enemy’s engage with W Winter’s Wrath.
Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, keep minions between you to block his approach. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and ability use, so fight outside its range and be ready to use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault after the taunt ends. If Rammus has increased his speed with Q Powerball, move away from the expanded landing area of R Soaring Slam, then leave the landing spot immediately.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge-up, and it knocks you up if it hits. If you see him charging behind a wall, interrupt him with whichever crowd control you can use: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on max health, so don’t stay close to Zac for long.
Zac.build: Zac's damage is mostly magic, so include Spirit Visage early in your core build and build magic resistance. It's efficient because Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so don't rely on building only health.
Zac.combo: If Zac E Elastic Slingshot is available, don't lead with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to engage. Walk up, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, and build stacks with basic attacks, then stun Zac with Sejuani E Permafrost. Land a basic attack immediately after the stun to deal Sejuani P Fury of the North's damage based on maximum health. Follow Zac with Q Arctic Assault if he tries to escape with E Elastic Slingshot, or interrupt his charge.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used, you have an opening to engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Check whether Zac Q Stretching Strikes' slow and knockup are also down before going in to reduce the risk of being crowd controlled.
Zac.fight: Make Zac use Zac E Elastic Slingshot, then close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and fight. Check before engaging whether Zac P Cell Division's revival is still available.
Zac.laning: Farm camps safely and level up early, then start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Briefly stop attacking camps just before a gank to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North's Frost Armor. Look for gank targets that an allied melee champion is attacking, since their attacks build stacks for Sejuani E Permafrost faster.
Zac.phase: Sejuani's ganks are slow early because she needs to build stun stacks, so focus on safe farming. Sejuani's win rate rises sharply once she completes three core items, but the data alone can't determine when she becomes stronger than Zac.
Zac.teamfight: If you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot charging, you can interrupt it with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If your allied damage dealers can deal damage immediately, hit an enemy backline damage dealer with R Glacial Prison from long range, then follow with Q Arctic Assault and lock them down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and E Permafrost. If your allies can't follow up, slow Zac's approach from the front with W Winter's Wrath and save R Glacial Prison.

Brand.build: Since most of Brand’s damage is magic, build magic resistance first and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance, making it effective. Brand P Blaze deals max-health-based damage, so don’t rely on health alone.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, go in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to knock him up. Land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, then build stacks with basic attacks and stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost. Immediately after the stun, land one basic attack to get Sejuani P Fury of the North’s bonus max-health-based damage.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so the moment after he uses Brand W Pillar of Flame is a chance to engage. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets that are ablaze, so engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when you aren’t ablaze. If you are ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear or wait for the fire to wear off before going in.
Brand.fight: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand isn’t ablaze, close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Brand has no mobility ability, and Brand Q Sear cannot stun without Blaze. Once you’re in range, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to slow him and build stacks for Sejuani E Permafrost.
Brand.laning: In the early game, farm camps safely to gain levels and start fights around allied lanes that already have an advantage. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait briefly so Sejuani P Fury of the North is active when you go in. A minion set ablaze by Brand may spread Brand E Conflagration within its area, so enter from the side of the wave.
Brand.phase: After completing three core items, use your defensive stats and the max-health scaling on Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to start fights.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out before engaging so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm don’t spread between allies. If your allied damage dealers can immediately damage Brand, hit him from long range with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, and Sejuani E Permafrost to lock him down. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the enemy engage with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath from the front and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when he hits you with spells in quick succession, then explodes, so focus on dodging his first spell, Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame. While you’re ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so move out of the projectile’s path or hide behind a minion. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from your allies to reduce its bouncing damage.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first against Ekko’s magic damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance, making you tougher with this build.
Ekko.combo: If Ekko still has a mobility ability available, don’t start with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to build stacks. Once they’re full, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack, then follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when he tries to escape using a mobility ability.
Ekko.escape: Start a full fight after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. If Ekko E Phase Dive is also just used, close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch him with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Ekko.fight: Look for a chance to catch Ekko right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, using Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase deep based on low health alone.
Ekko.laning: In the early game, farm camps safely to gain levels and start fights in lanes where your allies have an advantage and the enemy has a long distance to retreat. Before a gank, stop attacking camps to keep the Frost Armor from Sejuani P Fury of the North active, and check whether an allied melee champion’s basic attacks can help build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks.
Ekko.phase: In the early game, Sejuani is better off leveling safely than going for quick kills. The available information isn’t enough to say for certain which of Ekko or Sejuani is stronger at each stage.
Ekko.teamfight: With Frost Armor active and your allied damage dealers ready to attack immediately, look for an angle to hit Ekko from long range with Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then lock him down with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the engage with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath from the front and wait for the next fight.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid the marked area so you aren’t stunned and Ekko doesn’t gain a shield. Sidestep the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and don’t chase recklessly when you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, even when health is low.

Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main damage. If most of the damage you’re facing is magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build, and build some armor as well against Elise’s basic attacks.
Elise.combo: If Elise still has a mobility ability available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. Once stacks are full, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost. Immediately after the stun, land one basic attack to get Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault as Elise tries to escape with a mobility ability.
Elise.escape: The moment after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down is a good time to counterengage. You can also close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault right after Elise dashes in with Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, then lock her down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Elise.fight: Sejuani’s magic damage is effective against Elise’s low magic resistance. While Elise still has a way to move, don’t engage first with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault; walk in and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when Elise tries to get away.
Elise.laning: In the early game, farm camps safely to gain levels and secure vision so Elise can’t get kills with her ganks. When Elise is out of sight, don’t push the lane recklessly, and start fights around lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait briefly to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North’s defensive stats.
Elise.phase: Elise is threatening in the early game as she tries to build an advantage through ganks, so Sejuani should farm safely and avoid giving up kills. The available information isn’t enough to determine who is stronger late game, but Sejuani’s win rate rises sharply after completing three core items.
Elise.teamfight: If your allied damage dealers are in position to attack immediately, keep Frost Armor active and throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at Elise or an enemy backline damage dealer. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then lock them down with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the engage with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath from the front and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Elise.watch: If Elise E Cocoon hits you, she can follow up with an R Spider Form engage while you’re stunned, so keep a minion or jungle monster between you and Elise. When Elise switches to R Spider Form, watch for her attempts to finish off targets whose health has decreased, and be ready to use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North increases your own magic resistance, but Evelynn W Allure reduces it, so moving away before the mark matures takes priority. Evelynn E Whiplash deals max-health-based damage, so don’t rely on health alone.
Evelynn.combo: If Evelynn still has a mobility ability available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, then build stacks with basic attacks and stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost. Immediately after the stun, land one basic attack, then follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when she tries to escape with Evelynn E Whiplash or Evelynn R Last Caress. If your allies can deal damage immediately, hit her from long range with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then follow up with Q, W, and E.
Evelynn.escape: Move away before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, then look for a chance to fight after dodging Charm. If only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress, so look especially for a window before R comes back up and close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Then lock her down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Evelynn.fight: If Evelynn still has a mobility ability available, don’t dash in first with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Walk in and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and basic attacks, then stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost. Follow with Q when Evelynn tries to get away. Immediately after the stun, land a basic attack to get Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage.
Evelynn.laning: In the early game, farm camps safely to gain levels and start fights around lanes where your allies have an advantage. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North’s defensive effect, then go in.
Evelynn.phase: In the early game, farm safely and only invade Evelynn’s jungle when the situation is favorable.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets the backline, so protect your damage dealers where your team has vision and use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison to meet her engage. If your allied damage dealers can immediately deal damage, catch the target from long range with R, follow up with Q, then chain W and E. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the engage with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath from the front and save R.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, Charm is being prepared, so move away before it matures and alert your allies. After Charm, Evelynn E Whiplash’s max-health-based damage is dangerous, and when health is low after a fight, watch out for Evelynn R Last Caress as well.

Fiddlesticks.build: Fiddlesticks deals primarily magic damage, so build magic resistance early and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North increases her magic resistance, making magic resistance more effective.
Fiddlesticks.combo: If Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is available, walk in, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to build stacks, then stun with Sejuani E Permafrost.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Once Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap are down, you’re less at risk of being locked down by fear and silence.
Fiddlesticks.fight: While Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and engage. When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest begins, interrupt the channel with the Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani E Permafrost you saved.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to level up, then look for lanes where your ally has the advantage and the enemy has a long way to retreat. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait to activate Frost Armor, and keep vision in the brush behind the lane.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Early Sejuani needs to build stun stacks, so her ganks are slow. Level up safely.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in the bushes and approaches around objectives, and spread out so you don’t get hit by Fiddlesticks’s area abilities together. When your ally’s damage dealer can attack immediately, hit the enemy back line with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and chain Sejuani W Winter's Wrath into Sejuani E Permafrost.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channels before moving and dealing area damage. If you see it cast, interrupt it with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani E Permafrost. If you can’t interrupt it, move out of range. When Fiddlesticks hasn’t been visible for a while, watch bushes you have no vision of and narrow passages.

Gragas.build: Build magic resistance early against Gragas’s main damage and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance, increasing the value of resistance items. Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid builds that only stack health.
Gragas.combo: If Gragas E Body Slam is available, walk in instead of using Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first. Land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and build stacks with basic attacks, then stun with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack for its damage based on maximum health. Follow Gragas with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when he tries to escape with E Body Slam.
Gragas.escape: Engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault right after you bait out Gragas E Body Slam. If Gragas R Explosive Cask is also down, start the fight while the risk of being knocked back and disrupting your formation is lower. Don’t chase deep while Gragas E Body Slam is available.
Gragas.fight: When Gragas starts drinking with W Drunken Rage, deal your main damage after its damage reduction ends. When a barrel is placed, use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to leave its radius instead of fighting there.
Gragas.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to level up and start fights in lanes where your ally already has the advantage. Gank lanes where the enemy is pushed toward their turret and has a long way to retreat. Before engaging, avoid taking damage briefly to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North. Targeting the same enemy as an allied melee champion helps build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks faster.
Gragas.phase: Early on, watch for Gragas’s burst and ability to disrupt your formation, and level up safely as Sejuani. If you hold your formation in early and midgame objective fights, the matchup improves later as Gragas’s sustained damage falls off.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t leave your back line alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and watch narrow passages and bushes without vision. When an allied damage dealer can attack immediately, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at an enemy back-line damage dealer. If it hits, engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock them down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the enemy’s approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius. If you’re near the barrel when Gragas E Body Slam also hits, the damage and crowd control overlap, so watch your distance, especially in narrow passages. When Gragas R Explosive Cask is available, don’t stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team.

Hecarim.build: Build armor early against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. Armor won’t mitigate the magic damage from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread or Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows.
Hecarim.combo: If Hecarim E Devastating Charge or Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. Once you have enough stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and land a basic attack. Follow Hecarim with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when he tries to escape with a mobility ability. If your allies can deal damage immediately, hit him with Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range, then follow up with Q, W, E, and a basic attack after the stun.
Hecarim.escape: Don’t engage just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Look for an opening before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back, close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, and lock him down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Hecarim.fight: When Hecarim approaches, slow him first with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to reduce the attack damage and engage potential he gains from movement speed.
Hecarim.laning: Choose lanes for ganks where your ally already has the advantage and the enemy has a long way to retreat. Before engaging, avoid taking damage briefly to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North’s defensive effect.
Hecarim.phase: Early on, Hecarim clears camps quickly while Sejuani takes time to prepare a stun, so prioritize safe scaling over risky fights. The information provided isn’t enough to determine which champion has the advantage late game. Sejuani’s survivability and damage both improve as she builds defensive items.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t hit multiple people. If your ally’s damage dealer is in position to attack immediately, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at an enemy back-line damage dealer. If it hits, engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock them down with W Winter's Wrath and E Permafrost. If your allies can’t follow up, slow Hecarim’s approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save R.

Ivern.build: The greater danger is allies joining in on the crowd control from Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!, rather than Ivern’s own damage, so prioritize tenacity. If the enemy team’s damage is mostly magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build for magic resistance. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance.
Ivern.combo: If Ivern Q Rootcaller is available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. Once you have enough stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost. After Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and follow the same W, E, then basic attack sequence.
Ivern.escape: The moment after you bait Ivern Q Rootcaller is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock him down with Sejuani E Permafrost. When engaging a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, wait until the shield bursts.
Ivern.fight: While Ivern Q Rootcaller is available, don’t engage by using Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first. Walk in, build stacks with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, stun with Sejuani E Permafrost, then follow Ivern with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault the moment he tries to move. If a target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, engage after the shield bursts.
Ivern.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to level up and start fights in lanes where your ally already has the advantage. Gank lanes where the enemy has a long way to retreat to their turret, and before engaging, stop attacking camps and wait so you enter with Sejuani P Fury of the North active. Warding Ivern’s jungle early can reveal his path to harvest camps he has seeded, and watch out beside newly created Ivern W Brushmaker brushes.
Ivern.phase: As Sejuani builds defensive core items late game, both the defensive stats from Sejuani P Fury of the North and the damage from Sejuani W Winter's Wrath increase.
Ivern.teamfight: When your ally’s damage dealer can deal damage immediately, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at an enemy back-line damage dealer from long range with Sejuani P Fury of the North active. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock them down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost, aiming so Ivern R Daisy! doesn’t intercept your skillshot. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the enemy’s approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save your ultimate.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash to you, so keep a minion or terrain between you and Ivern before he casts it. Don’t engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until its shield bursts, leaving a slow. When Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid the knock-up from her repeated attacks.

JarvanIV.build: Buy Thornmail earlier if the enemy’s basic attack pressure is strong.
JarvanIV.combo: If you are at long range and your allies can follow up immediately, stun first with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then approach with Q and chain into W and E.
JarvanIV.fight: After stunning with Sejuani E Permafrost, land a basic attack to deal damage based on maximum health.
JarvanIV.laning: Early on, Sejuani should clear camps safely to level up and start fights in lanes where her ally has the advantage. Before ganking, wait briefly without taking damage to activate Frost Armor, then engage.
JarvanIV.teamfight: With Frost Armor active and your ally’s damage dealer ready to attack immediately, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at an enemy back-line damage dealer from long range. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock them down with W Winter's Wrath and E Permafrost.

Jax.build: First consider defensive items that reduce attack speed to counter Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. If the enemy team’s damage is mostly magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build.
Jax.combo: If Jax Q Leap Strike is available, save Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and walk in to build stacks with both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. Once you have enough stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack to deal Sejuani P Fury of the North’s bonus damage. Follow Jax with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when he tries to escape with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Jax.escape: Jax has an opening for you to close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault right after he uses Jax Q Leap Strike. Once Counter Strike ends, lock him down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t use basic attacks. Move out of its stun range and wait for it to end. Once Counter Strike is down, slow Jax and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, then stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and fight.
Jax.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to level up, then gank lanes where your ally already has the advantage and Jax has a long way to retreat. Before engaging, avoid taking damage briefly to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North’s defensive effect. If an allied melee champion can attack Jax, they can help build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks faster.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax engages with Jax E Counter Strike, don’t group nearby; wait for the area stun to end. Immediately afterward, lock him down with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison. Use Sejuani R Glacial Prison only when your ally’s damage dealer can deal damage immediately.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move outside its stun range. Jax Q Leap Strike can close the gap or help him escape, so don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first and give up your means of pursuit.

Karthus.build: Karthus’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance, but avoiding Karthus W Wall of Pain and leaving the area of E Defile quickly takes priority.
Karthus.combo: Engage Karthus with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to knock him up, then land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to fill the stacks. Follow with Sejuani E Permafrost to stun him, then land one basic attack to finish him with Sejuani P Fury of the North’s bonus damage based on maximum health.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility to create distance, so engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when you have a path around Karthus W Wall of Pain. If you cross Karthus W Wall of Pain to engage, it slows you and reduces your magic resistance, so approach around the wall.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no mobility to create distance, so close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault along a path that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain. Land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to slow him and build stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost, then land a basic attack for Sejuani P Fury of the North’s bonus damage.
Karthus.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to level up and start fights in lanes where your ally has the advantage and the enemy has a long way to retreat. Before engaging, avoid taking damage briefly to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North’s Frost Armor, and use an allied melee champion’s basic attacks to help build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks.
Karthus.phase: Sejuani becomes more durable as she completes core items late game, but account for the damage Karthus can still deal with Karthus P Death Defied after he dies.
Karthus.teamfight: With Frost Armor active and your ally’s damage dealer able to deal damage immediately, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison along an angle that can hit Karthus. If it hits, follow up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock him down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and E Permafrost, but move away from his corpse immediately after killing him. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the enemy’s approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save R.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals increased damage when it hits you alone, so watch its indicator and dodge on foot. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you when you cross it, so go around the wall. Even after killing Karthus, stay away from his corpse to avoid the Q Lay Waste and E Defile he casts with Karthus P Death Defied. After a fight, keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If the enemy team has heavy physical damage and many champions who engage at close quarters with basic attacks, get Thornmail earlier. Armor does not mitigate the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple.
LeeSin.combo: If Lee Sin still has a mobility spell, don't use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first. Walk in and fill the stacks with both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and basic attacks. Once stacks are full, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack to deal max-health bonus damage. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when he tries to escape with a mobility spell.
LeeSin.escape: The window after Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is used, before it returns, is a chance to engage. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is also down, close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch him with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is available, position so he can't get behind you.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early, retreat instead of accepting a duel. When fighting, check whether Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will are available. If he still has mobility, walk in and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. Right after Lee Sin uses Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage, focus your damage with allies while he lacks the shield and lifesteal.
LeeSin.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in allied lanes that already have an advantage. Choose lanes where the enemy is pushed toward their turret and has a long distance to retreat for ganks. Just before engaging, stop attacking camps and wait to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North's defensive effect.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so Sejuani should focus on gaining levels safely. Lee Sin falls off later, so secure objectives and lane advantages to buy time until then.
LeeSin.teamfight: Activate Sejuani P Fury of the North's defensive effect, then cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison at an enemy backline damage dealer when an allied damage dealer can attack immediately. On hit, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch them with W Winter's Wrath and E Permafrost. Before a teamfight, leave enough space between allies so Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage doesn't knock you into them.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will can use a ward to cross a wall, so keep your distance from walls where you lack vision.

MasterYi.build: Armor doesn't mitigate the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health as well. If the enemy team has heavy physical damage and many champions who engage at close quarters with basic attacks, get Thornmail earlier.
MasterYi.combo: If Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to fill the stacks. Don't waste your stun while Master Yi is using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. After he lands, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack. If he uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and then tries to create distance, follow with the Sejuani Q Arctic Assault you saved.
MasterYi.escape: The moment after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is used and he lands is a chance to engage. Close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and, if stacks are full, catch him with Sejuani E Permafrost. If an ally is in position to deal damage immediately, you can follow with Sejuani R Glacial Prison as well.
MasterYi.fight: While Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is available, don't engage first with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to build stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost, then use a basic attack to deal Sejuani P Fury of the North's bonus damage.
MasterYi.laning: Before a gank, avoid taking damage briefly to activate Frost Armor, and choose a lane where the enemy has a long distance to retreat. Master Yi is weak in the early jungle and at ganking, so take opportunities to secure early objectives with your allies.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi gets stronger as the game goes on, so don't delay advantages you can gain early.
MasterYi.teamfight: Group with allies and focus crowd control on Master Yi to deny him his first takedown participation. Wait for Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to end, then catch him with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. You can interrupt Master Yi W Meditate with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault's knock-up. Use Sejuani R Glacial Prison when an allied damage dealer can deal damage immediately.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can't be targeted while using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so look to use Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison just after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows don't work, so don't rely on Sejuani W Winter's Wrath's slow to create distance. Avoid taking prolonged hits from basic attacks empowered by Master Yi E Wuju Style's true damage.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance first against Nidalee's primary damage, and include Spirit Visage in your core item order. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants additional resistance based on your magic resistance, increasing the benefit of the resistance you build.
Nidalee.combo: If Nidalee W Pounce is available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. Once stacks are full, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost, then use a basic attack. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when Nidalee escapes with Pounce. If an ally can deal damage immediately, hit Nidalee with Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range, then engage with Q and follow with W and E.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce is a chance to close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Nidalee has no crowd control, so catch her with Sejuani E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison while Pounce is down.
Nidalee.fight: Don't use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to engage first while Nidalee W Pounce is available. Walk in, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost, then use a basic attack. If Nidalee tries to escape with Pounce, follow with the Q you saved.
Nidalee.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in allied lanes that already have an advantage. Before a gank, wait without attacking a camp to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North. Choose a lane where the enemy has a long distance to retreat, and use basic attacks from allied melee champions to build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks.
Nidalee.phase: Early on, Sejuani needs time to build stun stacks, so focus on growing safely. Later, build defensive items and start fights that allies can follow up on. The available information isn't enough to determine which of Nidalee or Sejuani is stronger at each stage.
Nidalee.teamfight: Watch where Nidalee steps out to throw her spear. When an allied damage dealer can attack immediately, catch her with Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range. If it hits, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If allies can't follow up, save R and slow the enemy engage from the front with W.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so dodge it by putting minions or your allied frontline between you and Nidalee. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack in jungle entrances and river paths as well. If you're hit by a spear or trap, save Sejuani Q Arctic Assault for when Nidalee closes in with Nidalee W Pounce.

Nocturne.build: Nocturne's main damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Q Duskbringer, and R Paranoia is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy team also has strong physical damage and many champions who stick to you with basic attacks, build Thornmail earlier. Armor doesn't apply to the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne R Paranoia is available, walk up, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, and fill your stacks with basic attacks. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the spell shield with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath first, then stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack on the stunned target. Follow Nocturne with the Sejuani Q Arctic Assault you saved if he tries to move away.
Nocturne.escape: The window while Nocturne R Paranoia, his mobility option, is down is an opportunity to engage. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is also down, there's less need to save Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to interrupt the fear.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne R Paranoia is available, walk up and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, then check for Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness before stunning him with Sejuani E Permafrost. Follow Nocturne with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when he tries to move away.
Nocturne.laning: Early on, farm camps safely to gain levels and gank lanes where your allies have an advantage and the enemy has a long distance to retreat. Wait briefly without attacking camps before going in to prepare Sejuani P Fury of the North's defenses. Keep vision in the river and jungle entrances, and if Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, don't run in a straight line; angle toward an ally or turret.
Nocturne.phase: Sejuani takes time to build stun stacks early, so level up safely. Later, build defensive items and fight with your allies, locking down enemies with stuns and slows.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, stay with your allies so no one gets isolated. If an allied damage dealer can deal damage immediately, cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at an enemy backline damage dealer. If it hits, use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to go in and lock them down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can't follow up, slow the approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Nocturne.watch: Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and doubles his attack speed when it does, so don't cast Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison immediately. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror needs to stay connected to trigger fear, so be ready to use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to create distance as soon as it connects. When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, don't get isolated; move to your allies immediately.

Nunu.build: Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and include Spirit Visage in your core build. This is especially effective because Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus resistance based on your magic resistance. You need Grievous Wounds against healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume, so get Executioner’s Calling or Morellonomicon early as well.
Nunu.combo: After dodging Nunu & Willump’s snowball or when you have an angle to catch them, engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to knock them up, then land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to build stacks. Once you have enough stacks, stun them with Sejuani E Permafrost and be sure to land one basic attack. If your allies can deal damage immediately and you have an angle from long range, stun them first with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then follow with Q and W.
Nunu.escape: Right after dodging Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever!, you have a chance to close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault because Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance. If you've been hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage and the root is approaching, or Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero has started, use Q to disengage or interrupt the channel instead of engaging.
Nunu.fight: Nunu & Willump can heal with Q Consume, so apply Grievous Wounds in extended trades. Stun them with Sejuani E Permafrost, then land a basic attack to get damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North.
Nunu.laning: Keep watching their pathing, as they may return for another gank via Scuttle Crab after ganking once. Sejuani should clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in lanes where allies have an advantage while Sejuani P Fury of the North is active.
Nunu.phase: In the mid game, after learning Sejuani R Glacial Prison, start fights your allies can follow up on. In the late game, your win rate rises sharply once you complete your third core item, so build defensive stats and fight alongside your allies.
Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, interrupt the channel with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, or leave its area if you can’t interrupt it. With Sejuani P Fury of the North active, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at the enemy backline when your allied damage dealers can follow up immediately, then catch them with Q, W, and E. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the enemy’s engage from the front with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and save R for the next fight.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! has long range and knocks you up on hit, so move toward the snowball instead of running back, and get out through the path Nunu & Willump took. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, you’ll be rooted after a delay, so immediately disengage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Don’t stay inside Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero; if possible, interrupt the channel with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: If Poppy E Heroic Charge is still available, don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first. Walk up and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to build stacks, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost, then land one basic attack. When Poppy tries to escape with E Heroic Charge, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, but wait for Poppy W Steadfast Presence to end if it’s active.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy uses E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then go in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch her with Sejuani E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison.
Poppy.fight: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t dash in. Walk up and use Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to slow her and build stacks. Once Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and W Steadfast Presence ends, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Even if Poppy is low on health, W Steadfast Presence gives her more defensive stats, so continue the fight only when you can secure the finishing damage.
Poppy.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait for Sejuani P Fury of the North’s Frost Armor to activate. Target lanes where the enemy has a long distance to retreat. When an allied melee champion attacks Poppy, Sejuani E Permafrost stacks faster.
Poppy.phase: Once you complete three core items, take advantage of your increased defensive stats, damage, and survivability to fight.
Poppy.teamfight: Activate Sejuani P Fury of the North’s Frost Armor, then throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at an enemy backline damage dealer when your allied damage dealers can attack immediately. After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, follow in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch the target with W Winter’s Wrath and E Permafrost. If your allies aren’t in position to follow up, slow the enemy’s engage from the front with W Winter’s Wrath and save R Glacial Prison.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault will be stopped, so wait until it ends or walk up. If Poppy E Heroic Charge knocks you into a wall, you’ll be stunned, so stay in open space. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave its area before the second strike. When Poppy charges R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek’Sai’s main physical damage. Armor can’t reduce the true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, but stacking max health alone also increases the damage from Rek’Sai R Void Rush. Get Thornmail earlier if the enemy has strong physical damage and many champions who stick to you with basic attacks.
RekSai.combo: If Rek’Sai still has a mobility ability, walk in and fill your stacks with both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and basic attacks, then stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost. Land one basic attack immediately after the stun to deal Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage. If Rek’Sai tries to escape with a mobility ability, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault.
RekSai.escape: After dodging the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, you have a chance to engage. If only Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, check whether Rek’Sai R Void Rush is still available. Before R Void Rush comes back up, close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch her with Sejuani E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison.
RekSai.fight: Before a fight, wait without taking damage so you can approach with the defensive stats from Sejuani P Fury of the North. If Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or R Void Rush is still available, don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to engage first. Walk in, build stacks with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, and stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault when she tries to escape with a mobility ability.
RekSai.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and wait for the defensive stats from Sejuani P Fury of the North. If you see an entrance to Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near a lane or your allied jungle, step on it to destroy it. Don’t walk alone through areas without vision.
RekSai.phase: In the early game, watch for Rek’Sai trying to gain an advantage with ganks and avoid giving up kills while you stall for time. In the late game, start fights where your allies can follow up with damage.
RekSai.teamfight: With your defensive stats ready, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at an enemy backline damage dealer your allied damage dealers can attack immediately. If it hits, go in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch them with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can’t follow up, slow Rek’Sai’s engage from the front with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
RekSai.watch: When Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow puts her underground, watch for her knock-up and move toward open space. Dodge with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault the moment she emerges. Immediately after you are hit by Rek’Sai’s poke, Rek’Sai R Void Rush may follow, so stay close to allies and don’t use targeted abilities while she’s leaping.

Rengar.build: Rengar’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. While Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt reduces your armor, the armor you’ve built is less effective. Get Thornmail earlier if the enemy has strong physical damage and many champions who stick to you with basic attacks.
Rengar.combo: After Rengar W Battle Roar is down, walk in, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, and fill your stacks with basic attacks. Once you have enough stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost, then land one basic attack on the stunned Rengar to deal the bonus damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North. If Rengar tries to escape with a leap, follow with the Sejuani Q Arctic Assault you saved.
Rengar.escape: After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, go in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, you have a chance to lock him down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty. If empowered Rengar W Battle Roar is still available, it can remove the stun, so confirm that he has used it before catching him with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If Rengar engages, knock him up with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and fight back with your allies.
Rengar.laning: Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels and start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Before a gank, stop attacking camps and go in with Sejuani P Fury of the North’s defensive effect active. When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside bushes and use Control Ward to secure vision.
Rengar.phase: Early on, Sejuani’s ganks are slow because she needs to build stacks for Sejuani E Permafrost before she can stun, so avoid risky fights with Rengar and gain levels safely. In the late game, defensive items also improve Sejuani’s survivability and damage, so start fights from a durable frontline.
Rengar.teamfight: Position your backline behind the frontline and within vision, then catch Rengar with immobilizing effects after countering his leap. If Rengar W Battle Roar is down and your allied damage dealers can attack immediately, start the fight with Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. If your allies aren’t in position to attack, slow the enemy’s engage from the front with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and save your ultimate.
Rengar.watch: Near bushes, watch for Rengar P Unseen Predator’s leap. If Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside bushes and use Control Ward to secure vision. When Rengar’s resource bar is full, empowered Rengar E Bola Strike roots and empowered Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control, so engage when the bar is empty.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate. If most of the enemy team’s damage is magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build. Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage when health is low, so build some health too.
Shaco.combo: If Shaco Q Deceive is still available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath to build stacks. Once you have enough stacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack to apply Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault the moment he tries to escape with Shaco Q Deceive.
Shaco.escape: The moment after Shaco uses Q Deceive is your chance to close the distance. Follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch him with Sejuani E Permafrost. Check for Shaco W Jack In The Box in areas without vision before engaging.
Shaco.fight: While Shaco Q Deceive is available, don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first. Walk in and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and a basic attack, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost, then land a basic attack. If he tries to escape with Shaco Q Deceive, follow with the Sejuani Q Arctic Assault you saved.
Shaco.laning: Farm safely and reach your levels early, then start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Keep vision at the entrances to your allied jungle to guard against Shaco’s early ganks and invades. Just before a gank, briefly stop attacking camps and go in with Sejuani P Fury of the North active.
Shaco.phase: In the early game, Shaco looks for advantages through ganks and invades, so avoid giving up kills and farm safely. If you buy time by taking objectives, Shaco’s ability to fight alone falls off in the late game.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco uses Q Deceive to enter a fight and reveals himself, immediately focus him with your allies. With Sejuani P Fury of the North active, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison at a target your allied damage dealers can attack right away. If it hits, follow in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch the target with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies aren’t in position to follow up, slow the enemy’s engage from the front with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives. Clear boxes first with Control Ward or Oracle Lens. If you don’t have either, start the objective from a position where you can retreat if you get caught. Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone explodes and leaves a box when it dies, so retreat immediately after killing the clone.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon’s Descent. If magic damage is the main threat, include Spirit Visage in your core build, and also build armor against basic attacks. Resistance can’t block the true damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike, and it also deals max-health-based damage, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shyvana.combo: If Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is still available, walk in and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. Once you have enough stacks, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost. Immediately land one basic attack after the stun to apply Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage. If Shyvana tries to escape with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault.
Shyvana.escape: The chance to pressure Shyvana comes when her Fury bar is empty and she can’t transform. If Shyvana has used R Dragon’s Descent, wait until she lands before catching her with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani E Permafrost. Also counterattack when Shyvana returns to human form and loses her bonus health and empowered abilities.
Shyvana.fight: Before a fight, briefly wait without taking damage to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North’s defensive stats. If Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is still available, don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first; walk in and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath. If Shyvana dashes, stun her after she lands, then follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if she tries to escape.
Shyvana.laning: Farm safely and reach your levels early, then start fights in lanes where your allies have an advantage. For ganks, choose lanes where the enemy has a long distance to retreat, and stop attacking camps just beforehand to keep Sejuani P Fury of the North active. If an allied melee champion can attack Shyvana, they can build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks faster.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana grows stronger over time, so use your early lane advantages and the windows when her Fury bar is empty to pressure her.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit by Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent’s path and area-of-effect abilities. If Shyvana dashes in, catch her after she lands with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at an enemy backline damage dealer when your allied damage dealers can deal damage immediately.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent is unstoppable during its dash, so don’t try to stop her mid-flight with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. Catch her with Sejuani E Permafrost after she lands. Considering the max-health-based damage from Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst, don’t stay in an extended fight with her.

Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first, considering the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. If you need to cleanse Skarner R Impale, decide in advance whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is still available, walk in, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, and fill the stacks with basic attacks. Immediately after stunning him with Sejuani E Permafrost, land a basic attack to get Sejuani P Fury of the North’s max-health-based damage. If Skarner escapes with E, follow with the Sejuani Q Arctic Assault you saved.
Skarner.escape: Immediately after forcing Skarner to use E Ixtal’s Impact is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and catch him with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If Skarner R Impale has already suppressed you, Sejuani Q Arctic Assault can’t get you out.
Skarner.fight: If Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is still available, don’t use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault first. Walk in and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and basic attacks, stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost, then land a basic attack. When Skarner tries to escape with E, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault.
Skarner.laning: Farm safely and reach your levels early, then start fights in lanes where your allies have an advantage. Choose lanes where the enemy is pushed toward their turret and has a long distance to retreat. Before engaging, briefly avoid taking damage to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North. Allied melee champions’ basic attacks also build Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, so watch which target they attack.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, Skarner becomes tougher and deals more damage as he builds tank items, so use fights and objective opportunities where your team has an advantage to delay his item timings.
Skarner.teamfight: With Sejuani P Fury of the North active, throw Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at a target your allied damage dealers can attack immediately. If it hits, follow in with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and chain W and E. If your allies can’t follow up, slow the enemy’s engage from the front with Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath and save R. Skarner R Impale ignores terrain and drags you along, so don’t stand against the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact passes through terrain, and he stuns you if he catches you and slams you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. Skarner R Impale is suppression and can’t be removed with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or a stun, so watch your position when entering Skarner’s short R range.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If the enemy team's damage is mostly magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build. Sejuani P Fury of the North grants bonus magic resistance based on her own magic resistance, so investing in resistance makes you tankier.
Taliyah.combo: Against Taliyah, walk up instead of leading with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to build stacks. Once stacks are full, stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack to trigger Sejuani P Fury of the North's bonus damage. If Taliyah tries to escape with a mobility spell, follow with the Sejuani Q Arctic Assault you saved.
Taliyah.escape: The window after Taliyah E Unraveled Earth's rock field disappears and before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back is a good time to engage with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. If only one of Taliyah's mobility options is down, she can escape with the other, so check whether she still has one available. Keep damaging Taliyah to prevent her from using Taliyah R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.fight: Walk around Taliyah's rock field and use Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to slow her and build stacks. Sidestep Taliyah Q Threaded Volley as you approach, then follow her with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if she tries to escape with a mobility spell. Sejuani's magic damage is effective against Taliyah's low magic resistance.
Taliyah.laning: Farm camps safely and level up early, then start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Choose a lane where the enemy has a long distance to retreat, and briefly stop attacking camps before going in to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North's Frost Armor. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, back off in advance in case she quickly intervenes in another lane.
Taliyah.phase: Sejuani's ganks are slow early because she needs to build stun stacks, so focus on safe farming. Once you have three core items, use your defensive stats and survivability to lead fights.
Taliyah.teamfight: With Sejuani P Fury of the North's Frost Armor active, cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at Taliyah when your allied damage dealers can attack her immediately. If it hits, approach along a route that avoids the rock field with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then lock her down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can't follow up right away, slow the approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Taliyah.watch: While Taliyah's rock field is still active, don't cross it with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can't change direction while being cast, so sidestep it.

Udyr.build: Account for the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and the mixed damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, but avoid building only health because of his maximum-health damage. If the enemy team's damage is mostly magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build.
Udyr.combo: If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is available, don't lead with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Walk up and build stacks with both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and basic attacks. Once stacks are full, stun Udyr with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack to apply Sejuani P Fury of the North's damage based on maximum health. Follow Udyr with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if he tries to escape with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, but apply immobilizing effects only after its awakened state ends.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is his main mobility option, so immediately after he uses it is an opportunity to close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. If the awakened state of Udyr E Blazing Stampede has ended, lock him down with Sejuani E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison. If you use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to engage, you've also spent your escape option, so check whether your allies can follow up before going in.
Udyr.fight: Once Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is removed, pressure him with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to slow him and build stacks. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already stunned you once, counterattack or retreat while he can't stun the same target again for a while. Don't rush to stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison before Udyr E Blazing Stampede's awakened state ends.
Udyr.laning: Farm jungle camps safely and level up early, then start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Briefly stop attacking camps before a gank so you go in with Sejuani P Fury of the North active. Track Udyr's path with vision at key routes and jungle entrances, and don't step forward in lane when he is out of sight.
Udyr.phase: Sejuani's ganks are slow early because she needs to build stun stacks, so level up safely. Once you have three core items, Sejuani's defensive stats and survivability are stronger, so start teamfights with your allies.
