Udyr.teamfight: Don't force an attempt to kill Udyr first while he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle; target a weaker enemy behind him. If your allied damage dealers can deal damage immediately, cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at a backline target, then follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and W Winter's Wrath after it hits. If your allies aren't in position to follow up, slow the enemy's engage from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save R Glacial Prison.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes in quickly and stuns, so watch for his first attack right after he activates it. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, and R also applies an area slow. Immobilizing effects don't work during the awakened state of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so wait until it ends before applying Sejuani's stun.

Vi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, Vi W Denting Blows, and Vi E Relentless Force. If the enemy team has strong physical damage and many champions who fight with basic attacks, build Thornmail earlier. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Vi.combo: If Vi Q Vault Breaker is available, don't lead with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault. Walk up and land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to fill the stacks, then stun Vi with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack. Follow Vi with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if she tries to escape with Vi Q Vault Breaker.
Vi.escape: Immediately after Vi uses Q Vault Breaker, you have an opening to engage while her mobility is down. Close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock her down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison. Save Sejuani Q Arctic Assault while Vi is using Vi R Cease and Desist, then use it after she lands.
Vi.fight: Close the gap right after dodging or forcing Vi Q Vault Breaker. Land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to slow Vi and build stacks, then stun her with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack. Keep the fight short instead of trading long enough for Vi W Denting Blows to stack.
Vi.laning: Farm camps safely and level up early, then start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Briefly stop attacking camps before a gank so you go in with Sejuani P Fury of the North's Frost Armor active. Choose a lane where the enemy has a long distance to retreat, and have an allied melee champion's basic attacks quickly build stacks for Sejuani E Permafrost.
Vi.phase: Sejuani's ganks are slow early because she needs to build stacks for Sejuani E Permafrost to stun, so focus on safe farming. In the late game, start fights alongside your damage dealers with defensive items built.
Vi.teamfight: With Sejuani P Fury of the North's Frost Armor active, cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at an enemy backline damage dealer when your allied damage dealers can attack them immediately. If it hits, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then lock them down with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and Sejuani E Permafrost. If your allies can't follow up, slow Vi's approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and save Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
Vi.watch: When Vi charges Vi Q Vault Breaker, back away or sidestep. Vi W Denting Blows reduces the target's armor and increases her attack speed as she keeps hitting the same target, so don't fight her for long. Don't use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault while Vi is charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist; wait until she lands and the knockup ends.

Viego.build: Build armor first to withstand Viego's main source of physical damage. If Viego's healing makes the duel drag on, consider Grievous Wounds; build Thornmail earlier if multiple physical-damage champions are fighting with basic attacks.
Viego.combo: If Viego W Spectral Maw or R Heartbreaker is available, don't lead with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to engage. Walk up, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, and fill the stacks with basic attacks; then stun him with E Permafrost and land one basic attack. Follow Viego with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if he tries to escape with a mobility spell.
Viego.escape: Don't engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. Before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, wait for his other mobility option to be down too, then close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock him down with E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison.
Viego.fight: Avoid small fights where Viego could get a kill. When you fight, land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to slow him, then stun him with E Permafrost and trigger Sejuani P Fury of the North's bonus damage with a basic attack. If Viego charges W Spectral Maw, sidestep or interrupt it with crowd control you have ready.
Viego.laning: Farm camps safely and level up early, then start fights in lanes where your allies have an advantage. Briefly stop taking damage before a gank to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North's defensive effect. Don't push a lane in the direction where Viego E Harrowed Path's black mist is visible; avoid that route or use a Control Ward.
Viego.phase: Sejuani's ganks are slow early because she needs to build stun stacks, so focus on safe farming and fights in favorable lanes. In the late game, building more defensive items helps Sejuani's survivability and damage, but don't give Viego a kill that could let him possess someone.
Viego.teamfight: With Sejuani P Fury of the North's defensive effect active, cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison at an enemy backline damage dealer when your allied damage dealers can attack them immediately. If it hits, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock them down with W Winter's Wrath. Where an ally has fallen, push Viego away or lock him down to prevent him from possessing them. Keep your distance while he is possessing someone and look for an opening when he returns to his original body.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw's stun lasts longer the longer he charges it, so sidestep when you see him charging. You can interrupt him while he charges with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, E Permafrost, or R Glacial Prison. When your health is low, stay back because Viego R Heartbreaker can target you easily, and avoid routes where you see the black mist.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress, and include Spirit Visage in your core build. Also build armor against his basic attack physical damage. If the duel drags on, get resistance first, then buy Executioner's Calling for Grievous Wounds.
Warwick.combo: Once stacks are full, stun Warwick with Sejuani E Permafrost and land one basic attack to trigger Sejuani P Fury of the North's bonus damage. Follow Warwick with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if he tries to escape with a mobility spell.
Warwick.escape: Engage after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has gone off and both Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast and R Infinite Duress are down. In particular, close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back, then lock him down with Sejuani E Permafrost or R Glacial Prison.
Warwick.fight: Don't dump your damage into Warwick while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; fight after the fear goes off. If Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast or R Infinite Duress is available, don't lead with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to engage. Walk up and build stacks with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and basic attacks, then stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost. Follow Warwick with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if he tries to escape with a mobility spell.
Warwick.laning: Farm camps safely and level up early, then start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Wait without attacking camps before a gank to keep Frost Armor active. If your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so recall even if you have to give up some farm.
Warwick.phase: Sejuani needs to build stacks for her gank stun early, so farm safely and don't give Warwick a kill.
Warwick.teamfight: With Frost Armor active, cast Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range at an enemy backline damage dealer when your allied damage dealers can attack them immediately. If it hits, follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, then lock them down with W Winter's Wrath and E Permafrost. If your allies can't follow up, slow Warwick's approach from the front with W Winter's Wrath and save R Glacial Prison.
Warwick.watch: Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals Sejuani's location when she is below half health and increases Warwick's movement and attack speed. While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and can fear you, so back away and reengage after the fear is used. Warwick R Infinite Duress is a suppression, and it reaches farther when his movement speed is higher, so keep plenty of distance even where you have no vision.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy team also has plenty of physical damage and many champions who engage with basic attacks, build Thornmail earlier. Keep in mind that armor doesn't block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.combo: If Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is available, don't lead with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault; walk up instead. Land both hits of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and build stacks with basic attacks, then stun Xin Zhao with Sejuani E Permafrost and land a basic attack. Follow Xin Zhao with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault if he tries to escape with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.escape: If Xin Zhao's empowered basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike has hit you twice, use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to get away before the third hit. Conversely, right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge, his mobility is down; close the gap with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and lock him down with Sejuani E Permafrost or Sejuani R Glacial Prison.
XinZhao.fight: Wait without taking damage just before a fight so you approach with Sejuani P Fury of the North active. After sidestepping Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning's thrust, use Sejuani W Winter's Wrath to slow him and build stacks, then stun him with Sejuani E Permafrost. Land a basic attack right after the stun to get the bonus damage based on maximum health.
XinZhao.laning: Farm camps safely and level up early, then start fights in lanes where your allies already have an advantage. Wait briefly without attacking camps before a gank to activate Sejuani P Fury of the North. Choose a lane where the enemy has a long distance to retreat, and check whether an allied melee champion can quickly build stacks for Sejuani E Permafrost with basic attacks.
XinZhao.phase: Sejuani takes time to build stun stacks early, so avoid forcing fights with Xin Zhao and farm safely. In late-game teamfights, counterattack as soon as Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's duration ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao can split your formation with the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard when he engages, so don't stand too close to your allies. With Sejuani P Fury of the North active, if your allied damage dealers can deal damage immediately, hit an enemy backline damage dealer with Sejuani R Glacial Prison from long range, then follow with Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. If your allies aren't in position to follow up, slow the approach from the front with Sejuani W Winter's Wrath and wait for an opening.
XinZhao.watch: Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike's third empowered basic attack knocks you up, so if you've been hit twice, use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault to get out of range before the third hit. Sidestep the later thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don't try to damage him from outside its range; wait for its duration to end.
